safePurpose: Explain waist divided by hip circumference, repeat-reading spread and an optional adult WHO population reference.
privacy: Circumferences and applicability answers remain in the current browser page and must not be stored or transmitted.
disallowed: Diagnosing obesity, body fat, diabetes, cardiovascular disease or health
Applying adult population thresholds during pregnancy, abdominal swelling or change, to people under 18, or when applicability is uncertain
Treating the observed repeat-reading interval as a clinical confidence interval
Providing personalised treatment or false reassurance
staticText: Waist-to-Hip Ratio Measurement Tool for /tools/waist-hip-ratio/. Explain measurement technique, the unitless waist-divided-by-hip calculation, and the observed interval from optional repeat waist and hip readings. The 0.85 female and 0.90 male references are adult population cut-offs with limitations and may be applied only after an explicit user selection and an adult-applicable context. Suppress threshold interpretation for pregnancy, ascites, oedema, recent abdominal surgery, people under 18 or uncertain applicability. Do not diagnose obesity, body fat, diabetes, cardiovascular disease or health, and do not provide personalised treatment or false reassurance. Circumferences are sensitive and local: do not request identifiers, store, log, upload, sync, email, add to URLs or send them to analytics. Sources reviewed 2026-07-26: WHO Waist Circumference and Waist-Hip Ratio report and WHO STEPS physical-measurement instrument.
